headline: Stay for the chat.
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
ONE finished promotional tile for the browser extension "YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen". REQUIRED moderately wide rectangular 11:7 canvas, 1760 pixels wide by 1120 pixels high (same shape as 440x280). Do not use a long panoramic shape. Entire complete standalone advertisement, not a contact sheet or browser screenshot.
Art direction: gorgeously crafted 16-bit pixel art, authentic crisp square pixels, nostalgic indie adventure game and sophisticated restrained monospace typography. A whole full-screen original game landscape is the canvas: midnight indigo/purple night sky with a few bright stars, rolling deep teal mountains, amber lantern village windows on floating/island stone platforms, waterfall and tiny original adventurer with red scarf crossing a bridge. Clearly ORIGINAL game design: no Mario, Zelda, Hollow Knight, Minecraft or other recognizable franchise/IP. Polished warm amber light, subtle teal sky atmosphere, rich pixel detail but cohesive clustered sprites. Nothing photorealistic.
Large beautiful pixel/monospace heading integrated in the night sky upper-left, exactly two lines "Stay for" then "the chat." in pale warm yellow. Tiny supporting extension name at top-left, exactly "YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen", but modest enough not to clutter. Main heading should be legible at 440x280 and take about left55% of canvas. Four pale-teal pixel fullscreen corner glyphs at outer canvas corners, crisp minimal.
At right-middle/lower INSIDE the same full-screen game scene place ONE dark-purple pixel-art live chat overlay, width about30% of canvas, with a subtle amber1-pixel border and clean pixel avatars. 3 generous chat rows exactly "nice run!", "LET'S GO", "GG!" in palecream/teal. At its bottom show a visually unmistakable wide pixel comment input exactly "Say something..." with a tiny amber send-arrow. Chat overlay overlaps game lightly, like an extension inside fullscreen video. No separate additional floating speech bubbles and no extra panels.
This is a lovingly made retro streaming editorial ad, not a children's illustration; fine pixel hierarchy, not random chunky pixel noise. Lively elegant composition with beautiful negative space, strong amber heading, readable at tile size, all key text and panel fully inside frame. No real creators, device, physical monitor, desk, room, browser bar, Chrome/YouTube logos, app store badges, ratings, charts, gradients, 3D glossy UI, watermark, or extra copy. Keep output11:7.

Main exactly spelled paleamber pixel headline "Stay for" then "the chat." occupies upper-left, wordmark "YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen" small at top. The game field fills entire11:7 canvas.
